q: Can I pre-order cakes and large orders?
a: Yes. For celebration cakes we recommend placing your order at least 48 hours ahead so we have time to bake and decorate. Use the Contact page to tell us your date.
Delivery costs Rs. 250 for orders under Rs. 5,000 and is free for orders of Rs. 5,000 or more.
Open any cake and choose a size, frosting, optional paid decorations and a personal message of up to 40 characters. The price updates as you choose.
Every product popup lists ingredients and common allergens. Our kitchen handles gluten, dairy, eggs and tree nuts, so please contact us before ordering if you have a serious allergy.

q: How should I store baked goods?
a: Keep cakes refrigerated and bring them to room temperature before serving. Croissants and breads are best the same day and can be refreshed in a warm oven.

q: Do you take bulk or corporate orders?
a: Yes. Send us the quantity, products and date through the Contact page and we will help you plan.

q: What is your return and cancellation policy?
a: Because baked goods are made fresh, we cannot accept returns. Orders can be changed or cancelled before baking begins. If something is not right, please contact us.

q: Is this a real online shop?
a: You can pay with Cash on Delivery (or cash at pick-up) or Online Payment by debit or credit card at checkout.
